keyword.en: how to read Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump pumping distance
keyword.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵输送距离怎么读

title.en: How Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump Orders Its Distance Cells
title.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Read each label
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离文字印成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。每一条标题只带它自己的数字。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有印出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。画面「Electric motor」的主体是Universal电机 3，不能代替这些格子。

h1.en: How Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump Orders Its Distance Cells
h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Read each label with its own figure. Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical cell is not filled from another model. The frame “Electric motor” shows Universalmotor 3 and does not replace these cells.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离文字印成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。每一条标题只带它自己的数字。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有印出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。画面「Electric motor」的主体是Universal电机 3，不能代替这些格子。

heading.en: Each distance label owns its figure
heading.zh: 每条距离标题只拥有自己的数字

body.en: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. The sheet already separates them when it prints both. Hopper Capacity 0.25 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm. Total Weight 1300 kg.
body.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。目录在同时印出两者时已经把它们分开。料斗容积 0.25 m³。最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm。整机重量 1300 kg。

heading.en: The frame is not a measuring tape

body.en: Source page: en.wikipedia.org, “Electric motor”. Subject: Universalmotor 3. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. If a distance cell is missing on the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing.
body.zh: 来源页：en.wikipedia.org，「Electric motor」。主体：Universal电机 3。河北品锦机械不从这一帧上读米数。拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. Neither cell is a metre. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。这两格都不是米。不要把别的厂家臂长贴到拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵上。

question.en: Which distance text does Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵印了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。

question.en: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the printed order.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留印出来的次序。

answer.en: No. Metres come from the catalogue cells that exist.
answer.zh: 不会。米数只来自已经印出的目录格。
